deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v5.1.0 -> 2% traffic (eu-north). change_window: 01:00-03:00 UTC. initiated by @emma. preflight running.

deploy-bot: Preflight summary:
```
checks: [tokenizer-compat, rerank-smoke, perf-quick]
baseline: OK
rerank-misorder: +2.4% on slice 'search-topk-10-longtail'
startup-p99: +18ms transient
```

emma: +2.4% rerank misordering on long-tail — above our 1% threshold. is this concentrated?
rajesh: ML team running A/B on the affected slice now. looks concentrated on numeric-prefixed queries and very long queries.
sre-olga: infra: no 5xx. small p99 bump on rerank service during warmup, CPU spike ~15s, likely cache miss.
pm-lucy: product sensitivity for search ordering is high. i'd prefer to pause before any percent increase beyond 2%.
ops-lee: prepare rollback/pin snippet just in case.
deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift to 2%...
```
action: shift_traffic(v5.1.0, 0.02)
status: in_progress
```

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 2% -> v5.1.0. canary instances reporting ready.

rajesh: A/B results (+5m): misorder still +2.2% on that slice. confusion concentrated on queries starting with numbers (e.g., "2023 report" variants). probable tokenizer/normalization change.
emma: that's a product-facing regression. vote=stop :no_entry_sign: do not ramp.
pm-lucy: vote recorded: HOLD. product requests rollback if ML confirms behavioral change and we can't mitigate quickly.
ops-lee: rollback command ready: `deploy rollback --to v5.0.9 --region eu-north && pin-version v5.0.9 --reason "canary rerank misorder"`
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 2% by operator hold. automated rollback disabled for this rollout.

pm-lucy: release-note blurb (short): "Paused v5.1.0 rollout in eu-north due to a reranking regression on long-tail numeric queries; investigating tokenizer normalization differences."
rajesh: ML action items: (1) diff tokenization outputs between v5.0.9 and v5.1.0 on the slice, (2) propose quick patch or revert.
sre-olga: infra action: validate cache priming on canaries and restart nodes if CPU spike recurs.
emma: reconvene in 20m. if no acceptable mitigation, execute prepared rollback/pin.
pm-lucy: marking change window as PAUSED in tracker and notifying stakeholders. :rotating_light:
